concepts: Use case: ui-mockup. Deliver a high-fidelity raster desktop website design exploration for Clippster, a video clipping/editing desktop application. This is a website screenshot mockup, not a photo of a monitor, no browser chrome. Keep actual brand identity: white bold italic script Clippster wordmark and abstract opposing triangular play shapes, near-black #0a0a0b, charcoal #141416, main cyan #06b6d4 and lighter #22d3ee, white text. Refine existing system sans typography as specified. Show real task-based visuals: source video, detected clip ranges, audio waveform, captions, multitrack editor, reframing, publish. All product interface illustrations are conceptual, not actual screenshots; add a discreet readable 'Conceptual product visualization' caption. Use realistic coherent sample mountain biking creator footage within product previews, not unrelated stock hero photography. Header logo left, Product / Workflow / Pricing links, Download right. No fake metrics, testimonials, customer logos, promises of viral performance, glassmorphism, neon glow, purple-blue gradients, repetitive feature-card grids, or giant rounded containers. Use crisp readable copy, careful spacing, thin dividers. Platform names only as source or publish labels. Primary CTA 'Download Clippster', secondary 'Explore the workflow', small 'macOS & Windows'. Provide polished agency-quality layout with hero and next section visible. CONCEPT 01: THE CLIP ENGINE. 1536x1280 desktop viewport. Asymmetrical composition: top hero left 40% contains small cyan label 'FROM STREAM TO SHORT', bold clean tight grotesk headline 'Long streams.\nStandout clips.' about 76px, brief supporting text 'Find the moments. Make the edit. Share your best work.' CTA row below. Right 60% and lower hero contains exquisitely detailed isometric editing pipeline on an extremely restrained graphite grid. A long horizontal video filmstrip/waveform enters from back-left, cyan selected moments lift slightly from its plane, feed a dimensional multitrack editing slab, and become three upright short-form video exports. Precise shallow extrusions, no clouds or network server imagery, no decorative random geometry. Label small stages '01 Capture', '02 Find', '03 Edit', '04 Publish'. Strong high contrast legible hero; diagram subtle but not invisible. At lower quarter after thin divider begin full-width section 'The moment is already there.\nBring it into focus.' alongside a straight-on waveform with selected cyan clip spans and synchronized transcript. Keep content grounded in video editing. Footer of viewport tiny '01 / THE CLIP ENGINE — DESIGN EXPLORATION'.

fullPage: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished FULL-PAGE DESKTOP landing page mockup expanding reference concept 01 for Clippster. Reference is design continuity input, not a literal image to paste. Output tall 1536x4096 approximately, desktop width maintained throughout, full page from header through footer. Preserve near-black #0a0a0b, charcoal, cyan #06b6d4, white, exact headline 'Long streams. Standout clips.' and isometric video editing pipeline hero. Refine logo toward existing white script Clippster wordmark; no new icon redesign. No glow or gradients, no fake metrics or testimonials or pricing. Sections in coherent order: (1) Header Product Workflow Pricing and Download, hero left copy and CTAs, right isometric stream filmstrip through cyan selected highlights and multitrack editor into 3 vertical clips. (2) Thin source strip explicitly labeled 'CAPTURE FROM' with text Twitch / Kick / YouTube / Rumble / X / Pump.fun, no customer endorsement. (3) AI section 'The moment is already there. Bring it into focus.' paired with horizontal waveform, 3 selected ranges and synchronized transcript, tiny 'Illustrative detection results'. (4) Full-width live capture section 'Catch it while it happens.' left believable livestream preview with LIVE tag and inset clip capture control, right short copy 'Capture live moments without leaving the stream.' and restrained DVR ruler. (5) Editorial near-white section 'Your cut. Your call.' with large detailed straight-on multitrack editing workspace, media sidebar, mountain biking preview, inspector, captions and audio timeline. Short typographic feature row 'Trim precisely / Shape the frame / Add captions / Mix the sound'. (6) Return dark section 'One story. Every format.' a landscape preview connected to 9:16 and 1:1 crop previews using same coherent mountain biker footage; small format labels. (7) Publish section 'Finish here. Publish everywhere.' narrow realistic scheduling list with rows TikTok / YouTube Shorts / Instagram Reels / X and concise text 'Organize, schedule, and share your finished clips.' No fake actual account data. (8) Spacious final CTA 'Your next great clip starts here.' cyan Download Clippster button, macOS & Windows. Footer wordmark Product / Pricing / Privacy / Terms. Preserve strong typography, intentional generous breathing space and variation across sections. Not a feature-card grid. Make every major heading legible and all sections clearly delineated. All UI and generated mountain biking footage are conceptual; discreet caption 'Design exploration — conceptual product visuals' in footer.
